name: Ahmad bin Jamal
bio:
Ahmad's journey in motorsport began with a childhood fascination for go-karting, fueled by his father's involvement as a race mechanic. He honed his technical skills through vocational training and later earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Universiti Teknologi Malaysia. Starting as a junior technician, Ahmad quickly rose through the ranks, demonstrating a knack for problem-solving and team leadership.

As Head of Operations for Proton by Premotion, Ahmad prioritizes streamlined workflows and fostering a collaborative environment. He believes in empowering his team, encouraging open communication, and implementing innovative solutions to optimize performance. Known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to adapt to changing circumstances, Ahmad is a valuable asset to the team, ensuring smooth race operations and driving continuous improvement.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Ahmad is a man of average height with a strong build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every day with a cup of strong teh tarik.
